items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: Punch took it. He had to go... Hutchinson was laughing... He was laughing at Punch you know... Here come Punch... Punch cut loose there

ctx.x: Punch took it. He had to go. Don't call that panamore you know. And Hutchinson was laughing, you know. He done played panamore too. He come from down that way or something. He was laughing at Punch you know. Nah, Punch. No, there was somebody else playing. Here come Punch, that's the way it was. Punch cut loose there with some wire around you know. Hudson got up and said, well, music is going to hell. And shortly after that, Manuel Moneta got a job next door with Butcher Fernandez's place. Him and Benji was…
Nice little band over there. Chattron trumpet.
